proposedPromotion.proposedRule: Add a fifth adjustment class, schedule replacement, at status tentative_review_required. A template's native reveal, hold and exit schedule may be replaced with a cue schedule derived from the visual contract, including independent per-element visibility control. Decorative motion may lead into a cue; names, labels and final values must be fully readable at the cue; holds must survive the template's own exit animation. PROVEN only where a render and hold check exists. Any other template may be proposed with schedule replacement, but the candidate is flagged as unproven and forced to review rather than assumed to retime cleanly. Same handling as flexibleCapacity and darkStyle in answer 23.
